reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount by calling the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper, which already encodes the null/number/range-furthest-from-zero rule used by forecast, schedules app and templates.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the only new code is one field assignment and a type.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, the layer that maps internal schedules to the API shape, with the handler type updated in api-handlers.ts.

scope.why: Touches only the API model, handler type, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Simple and clear; the new APIScheduleListItem type makes toExternal's return a list-specific shape, a small naming oddity if toExternal is reused elsewhere.
